01

“By the dawn”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 89:1).

01
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 01

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabiʿ narrated to us, from al-Aghar, from Khalifa ibn Husayn, from Abu Nasr, from Ibn ʿAbbas, regarding His saying:
By the dawn [al-Fajr: 1], he said: “It is the dawn that you see from the east; he says: the dawn of the day.” Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, the like of it.
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ، عَنْ خَلِيفَةَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَصْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَالْفَجْرِ [الفجر: 1] قَالَ: " هُوَ الْفَجْرُ الَّذِي تَرَوْنَ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ يَقُولُ: فَجْرُ النَّهَارِ ". أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، مِثْلَهُ
Edition record 373833 · p. 726Link to report ↗
02

“and the even and the odd”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 89:3).

02
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 02

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabiʿ narrated to us, from al-Aghar, from Khalifa, from Abu Nasr, from Ibn ʿAbbas:
and the even and the odd [al-Fajr: 3], he said: “The even is the Day of Adha (Sacrifice), and the odd is the Day of ʿArafa.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ، عَنْ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَصْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ [الفجر: 3] " قَالَ: الشَّفْعُ: يَوْمُ الْأَضْحَى ، وَالْوَتْرُ: يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ "
Edition record 373834 · p. 726Link to report ↗
03
Report from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
“Everything that God (ﷻ) created is even: the heaven is even, the earth is even, land and sea, the sun, the moon and the human being — all of this is even; and the odd is God, the One, the Overpowering.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
«كُلُّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل فَهُوَ شَفْعٌ، السَّمَاءُ شَفْعٌ، وَالْأَرْضُ شَفْعٌ، وَالْبَرُّ وَالْبَحْرُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالْإِنْسَانُ هَذَا كُلُّهُ شَفْعٌ، وَالْوَتْرُ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ»
Edition record 373835 · p. 726Link to report ↗
03

“Is there in that an oath for one of perception (dhī ḥijr)?”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 89:5).

04
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 04

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabiʿ narrated to us, from al-Aghar, from Khalifa ibn Husayn, from Abu Nasr, from Ibn ʿAbbas:
Is there in that an oath for one of perception (dhī ḥijr)? [al-Fajr: 5]: “for one of intellect, for one of opinion, for one of capability, for one of understanding.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ، عَنْ خَلِيفَةَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَصْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
هَلْ فِي ذَلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذِي حِجْرٍ [الفجر: 5] «لِذِي عَقْلٍ، لِذِي رَأْيٍ، لِذِي قُدْرَةٍ، لِذِي نُهًى»
Edition record 373836 · p. 727Link to report ↗
04

“Iram”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 89:7).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
Iram [al-Fajr: 7], meaning: “the ancient.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِرَمَ [الفجر: 7] ، يَعْنِي: «الْقَدِيمَةَ»
Edition record 373837 · p. 727Link to report ↗
06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
possessors of pillars [al-Fajr: 7], he said: “They were people of the tent-pole; they did not settle.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ [الفجر: 7] قَالَ: «كَانُوا أَهْلَ عَمُودٍ، لَا يُقِيمُونَ»

05

“so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 89:13).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment [al-Fajr: 13], he said: “meaning that with which they were punished.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ [الفجر: 13] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الَّذِي عُذِّبُوا بِهِ»
Edition record 373839 · p. 727Link to report ↗

“with immense love”

Explanation from Mujāhid 08

English
Transmission wording

07

“O reassured soul”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 89:27).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
O reassured soul [al-Fajr: 27], meaning: “the humble one, reassured toward its Lord.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
